 Vast areas of the Emirates will face wet weather this week, with strong winds set to bring dusty conditions
 The National November 09, 2026
 Add on Google 
 Rain is expected to hit Abu Dhabi and Dubai this week, accompanied by high winds and dust sweeping across the country.
 Temperatures in Dubai are forecast to drop from 34°C on Monday to 29°C by Friday, signalling the end of sweltering conditions.
 The Northern Emirates face the most unsettled conditions, with winds reaching 45kph, reducing visibility due to lifted dust.
 November typically brings cooler temperatures, with the UAE averaging 24.8°C across the month as the country approaches its winter season.
 The National Centre of Meteorology said the UAE averages just 2.5mm of rainfall in November, far less than the 11.3mm expected in December.
 Rain is expected to hit Abu Dhabi and Dubai this week, with high winds and dust set to sweep the country. 
 The National Centre of Meteorology said light rainfall is on the horizon in both emirates on Wednesday and Thursday, in its latest five-day weather bulletin. 
 More wet weather is forecast for Ras Al Khaimah, Sharjah and Fujairah from Tuesday, while winds could hit speeds of up to 45kph in some areas, lifting dust up into the skies and hampering visibility. 
 What's the weather like in Abu Dhabi and Dubai in November?
 Read More Arrow The unsettled weather is to bring a drop in temperatures, offering respite to residents after sweltering conditions stretched from summer into autumn. 
 The NCM projects that daytime temperatures will steadily drop in Dubai throughout the week, dipping from a high of 34°C on Monday to 29°C on Friday. 
 In Abu Dhabi, the mercury is forecast to peak at 35°C on Monday, dropping to 32°C by Friday. 
 The Northern Emirates in particular have experienced unstable weather in recent weeks, with heavy rain, fog and hail reported in some areas.

 November typically brings with it cooler conditions - and a chance of scattered rainfall - as the UAE approaches its long-awaited winter season. 
 The average temperature for November - combining both daytime and evening forecasts - is 24.8°C, according to the NCM's latest monthly climate report. 
 While more rainy days could be on the way, November is typically much drier than the period from December to April. 
 Official NCM figures – covering 2003 to 2022 – show the UAE averages about 2.5mm of rain in November. 
 In contrast, the country can expect 11.3mm of rainfall in December, with more than 10mm usually falling in January. 
 Residents are advised to check daily weather forecasts for wet days ahead, while making the most of the largely dry weather during the month.
